caption: The drawing depicts a single spur, composed of both metal and leather elements, set against a plain, light-colored background. The main body of the spur is metallic, primarily rendered in shades of gray and silver, featuring engraved or embossed decorative patterns. Attached to one end is a large, circular rowel with multiple pointed spokes, colored in a darker brownish tone. Adjacent to the rowel, the metal arm of the spur arches into an oval shape, forming the heel band, which is connected to a series of brown leather straps and buckles. The leather components, varying in hue from medium to dark brown, are textured and equipped with metal buckles for fastening, with one strap featuring a teardrop-shaped end. Additionally, a small chain of interlinked metal is attached to the bottom of the spur. The composition is centered, with the object oriented horizontally and occupying the central portion of the image. The background remains unadorned except for a small artist’s signature, "VERNA TALLMAN," in the lower right corner.
title: Spur
